blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — Lapu-Lapu City currently has 21 drug-cleared barangays and one drug-free barangay after these communities passed the evaluation of the Regional Oversight Committee on Barangay Drug Clearing. Pusok and Punta Engaño were among the barangays recently recognized as drug-cleared. Other drug-cleared barangays include Suba-Basbas, Calawisan, Bankal, Pajo, Pajac, Babag, Ibo, Buaya, and Agus, along with the 10 barangays on Olango Island. Meanwhile, Caohagan was the only barangay in the city declared drug-free.
